annotations.title: Connect Stripe or GitHub through the dashboard

description: Hand the user the page that wires Stripe or GitHub to an app: they paste a provider key there, and AnyHook registers the app's inbound URL as a webhook at the provider, saves the signing secret it yields, and turns on signature verification at the edge. The key goes from the user to AnyHook, never through this conversation, and is not stored. Without appSlug a new app is created for the provider first. GitHub sends a signed ping once connected, so the first event appears within seconds (anyhook_events). Until the app has a destination (anyhook_destination_add), events are received and logged but not forwarded.

api_key.description: Legacy field, ignored. Connect with ANYHOOK_API_KEY in the stdio client configuration.

appSlug.description: Connect this existing app. Omit to create a new app for the provider.

provider.description: The provider to connect. Names the new app when appSlug is left out; Stripe if omitted.
